assessment: Automatic proof search and conditional inventory reuse are functioning in this finite model. The successful geometry certificate was discovered without a handwritten target proof, and the saved execution shows an arithmetic-derived pattern attaching to a new geometric formula family.

The useful observation is structural transfer, not RL success. The frozen-policy lane has no learned numerical distinction from its initial ranking. Different censored timeout traces cannot be attributed to learned weights.

Clusters cut the successful point search from six branches and four backtracks to two branches and no backtracks, but cold preparation and matching made the cluster lanes slower. Fewer branches are not a cost advantage.

The comparison is mixed: lexical point search exhausted one declared finite coarse catalogue while the DAG control remained UNKNOWN; the DAG control exhausted five other finite cases while point searches remained UNKNOWN. Neither type of finite exhaustion proves unrestricted original-theory impossibility.

The immediate research priority is compact, proof-preserving catalogue and witness generation, followed by a training curriculum that actually executes useful proposals. Increasing model capacity or claiming an RL gain before that would skip the bottleneck exposed by this experiment.

Only the typing axiom occurs in the searched positive. The proof asserts neither existence of an incident object nor that the named constant satisfies a Line predicate. No searched arithmetic, equality, incidence-uniqueness, order or induction theorem was found in this cohort.
findings: Four verified closed lemmas were acquired from six earlier automatically discovered certificates. Their proof DAGs supplied 63 formula-erased patterns (199 donor occurrences).

One new held-out statement was proved by all four strategies: the nested-function incidence-typing specialization. Its four coarse rows expand to the same nine-line proof from the original typing axiom. No target proof script was supplied.

A three-node pattern mined from arithmetic add-zero proofs was instantiated in this geometry proof, with universal instantiation supplied through an external receptor. Both cluster lanes executed two preferred placements and two forced placements.

Training did not learn numerical weights: four of six episodes never searched because their catalogues were incomplete; the other two returned UNKNOWN with zero preferred-placement credit. Frozen numerical means and counts remained empty.

Only eight of fifteen catalogues completed. Five held-out builds remained UNKNOWN, so the 48 planned lane outcomes contain 20 lanes that never searched. All 28 executed held-out searches and all failures are retained.

On the successful case, lexical point search took 0.000736 s, uniform clusters 0.030609 s, frozen policy 0.030481 s and shared-DAG search 0.010782 s. These are single cold observations with shared compilation; no statistical speedup is established.

The original worker completed in 146.797 s with 483,246,080 bytes peak RSS. It made 43 proof-check requests: 20 genuine current native-plus-independent checks and 23 exact-certificate memo hits. Authored controls are included in those totals, not counted as discovered theorems.
